strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: yettwali tafelwit n usmel n tura mgal aḍris n usbeddi n Google (CRL) yerna yettɛerriḍ aṭas n yiɣbula alamma yufa tafelwit n usmel iwulmen, s usmel aṭumatik d uɛiwed n yiweẓla Google. Yettkemmil deg yal lḥebs yerna yeḥwaǧ internet (1-3 n tedqiqin).
strings.mdKbNet: • Tafelwit n tmeẓdit seg uẓeḍḍa: tessufuɣ-d tafelwit n tmeẓdit seg uɣerbaz unṣib (GitHub) yerna tessexdam-itt deg /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Teḥwaǧ internet yerna tettaṭṭaf 1-3 n tedqiqin. Yettwaseqdac mi ara yeɣli smart fetch neɣ mi ara yettwabeddel usmel s ufus.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP asekcem: yettwali iferdisen n Useqdec n Tmeẓdiyin n Uɛeṭṭel yellan, yettwali TEE talɣa n uselkin n usnefli, yerna yesskanay-d talɣa n wallalen KmInstallKeybox. Ur yettbeddil ara kra — tamuɣli n tegnit n usmel s tɣawla.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine asefqed (aɣer kan): yesskanay-d Widevine imeslayen n uswir (L1/L3) seg dumpsys, tilin n ufaylu n tmeẓdit n DRM (IDM), d tɣawsiwin n unagraw icudden ɣur-s. Ur yettbeddil ara kra akk.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Asenfar n ufus RKP: yettkemmil sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh afus. Yessefray timsal n usnefli mi ara yeɣli uɛeddi aṭumatik. Yal tikli tessuffuɣ-d yiwen n lḥirfa ibanen n rrbeḥ/lfeɛl.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Yettḥadar lḥalat ẓẓayen yerna yettaṭṭaf aṭas n wakud. Agmuḍ ibanen yettban-d deg taggara.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Asenqed GMS: yesfeḍ isefka n yiweẓla Play Store d Google (GMS+GSF) yerna yettɛawad aselkim s wudem awurman. I uskasi n tɣawsiwin s tɣawla kan — ur yettaṭṭaf ara tisura-inek neɣ ifuyla-inek.
strings.mdCertify: • Aselkin n urar: yettwali lḥala n uselkin n RKP n wallal yerna yettbeddilen iferdisen n uselkin ma yella ilaq. Ur yettaṭṭaf ara isefka n useqdac.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER aseggem: yessefray Google timsal n ukatar n yiweẓla (SOTER) icudden ɣer usnefli n wallalen. Yettwaseqdac i kra n yifarisen yettkelfen s SOTER deg umḍiq n Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Sseqdec PIF: yettkemmil sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh s tezmert. Yettwaseqdac aḍris n uḍar yettwafernen (adigan/aɛlayan) yerna yettbeddilen ifuyla pif.prop/pif.json. Agmuḍ ibanen yettban-d deg uḍris.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF tcekkaṛt: yesskanay-d aḥric n umuṭu yettwasbedden, ifuyla n tmeẓdiyin (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), d yifuyla. Segzi kan — ur yettbeddil ara kra.
strings.mdCanary: • Asnefli n tkanarit: yettkemmil sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Yettawi-d aẓeḍḍa aneggaru n Canary Engine akken ad iḍmen asemres akked yiselkin RKP i d-yettwaḥettmen (Ferber 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Asekcem n umuṭu : yettwali lḥala TrickyStoreOSS (pid, iɣmisen), ifuyla n tfelwit n tmeẓdiyin (axeddam mgal aseqdac), aḍris n tmeẓdiyin n tidet vs yettwasqedcen, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP tmeẓdiyin. Asekkil n tdiagnostikt kan.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module yettḍafar snat n tfelwiyin n tmeẓdiyin : tamezwarut (taɣerfant, ur yettwasfeḍ ara) d tis snat (taɣellist). Tabdart-a tesskanay-d anwa adeg i yettwasqedcen, yettbeddil asenfar, neɣ yesnernay asnas ɣer umezwaru s usuter ibanen — s tɣawsiwin n uḍfar d uɣmis ikemlen.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Asekcem n tɣellist : yettwali asekcem n tmeẓdiyin TEE, asenqed n temkarḍit daxel n keystore2, aḥric n usbeddi (CRL), aḍfar n usmel n uḥareb d aḥric RKP. Taɣuri kan — ur yettbeddil acemma.
